datasets.title: Travel time to services
datasets.description: Modelled travel time from the Malaria Atlas Project global friction surfaces (1 km): to the nearest health facility (2019) and to the nearest city of 50,000+ (2015).
datasets.source: Malaria Atlas Project accessibility (Weiss et al. 2018, 2020) via Earth Engine

fields.label: Travel time to a health facility (motorised)
Travel time to a city of 50k+

datasets.title: Air quality: aerosol index (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean Sentinel-5P UV absorbing aerosol index: smoke and dust haze. Above ~1 is notable; native pixels ~7 km.
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 AER_AI via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data, free and open

datasets.title: Air quality (satellite)
datasets.description: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI column means for 2025 (NO₂, CO, aerosol index, HCHO; ~5 km native) and the Washington University satellite-derived surface PM2.5 (V6.GL, ~1 km, latest year 2022). Columns are not ground concentrations; use for spatial contrast.
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 + ACAG V6.GL.02 PM2.5 (awesome-gee-community catalog) via Earth Engine
datasets.license: Copernicus open licence; PM2.5 free for research (WUSTL ACAG)

datasets.title: Built-up area (GHSL)
datasets.description: Built surface, non-residential share, 2000→2020 expansion, built volume and height from GHSL R2023A (100 m); degree of urbanisation from GHS-SMOD (1 km).
datasets.source: JRC GHSL GHS-BUILT-S/V/H + GHS-SMOD R2023A via Earth Engine

datasets.title: Built-up land, 1975–2020
datasets.description: Share of each cell covered by buildings in each GHSL epoch (every 5 years), from Landsat and Sentinel-2. Play it to watch the city grow.
datasets.source: JRC GHSL GHS-BUILT-S R2023A via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Air quality: CO column (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean Sentinel-5P TROPOMI carbon monoxide column: crop-residue and biomass burning, traffic and industry. Native pixels ~7 km.
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 CO via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data, free and open

datasets.title: Urban growth
datasets.description: Share of each cell built up in 2016 and 2023 (Google Open Buildings Temporal), the change, and the CA-ML probability it is urban by 2035.
datasets.source: Open Buildings Temporal via Earth Engine (pipeline/growth; other cities: scripts/build_cell_growth.py)

datasets.title: Land cover (ESA WorldCover)
datasets.description: Share of each cell in each ESA WorldCover 2021 class (10 m Sentinel-1/2 classification), plus the dominant class.
datasets.source: ESA WorldCover v200 (2021) via Earth Engine

datasets.title: Land cover by year, 2016–2025
datasets.description: Yearly mean Dynamic World class probability from every Sentinel-2 scene: how much of each cell reads as built-up, trees, water or crops. Recent change at 10 m detail, averaged to the cell.
datasets.source: Google / WRI Dynamic World V1 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Land surface temperature (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean MODIS Terra+Aqua land surface temperature, day and night. Cloudy monsoon months have gaps.
datasets.source: MODIS MOD11A2/MYD11A2 v6.1 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Law & order mobility
datasets.description: Where emergency movement can be choked or sealed off (docs/MOBILITY_MODEL.md).
datasets.source: pipeline/safety/mobility.py

datasets.title: Vegetation NDVI (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean MODIS 250 m NDVI (Terra+Aqua 16-day composites). Shows the monsoon green-up and the dry-season brown-out.
datasets.source: MODIS MOD13Q1/MYD13Q1 v6.1 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Night lights (VIIRS)
datasets.description: VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly composites (stray-light corrected), median of 2025 and change since 2015. Native ~460 m, so neighbouring 244 m cells share values. A proxy for economic activity and electrification.
datasets.source: NOAA/EOG VIIRS DNB monthly VCMSLCFG via Earth Engine
datasets.license: Public domain (NOAA EOG; credit Earth Observation Group)

datasets.title: Night lights (monthly)
datasets.description: VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly radiance, stray-light corrected. Tracks built-up activity, electrification and festival lighting.
datasets.source: NOAA EOG VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Air quality: NO₂ column (monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly mean Sentinel-5P TROPOMI tropospheric NO₂ column. Traffic and combustion raise it; native pixels are ~5.5 × 3.5 km, so neighbouring cells share values.
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 NO2 via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data, free and open

datasets.title: Air quality: PM2.5 (monthly, modelled)
datasets.description: Monthly mean surface PM2.5 from the CAMS global forecast model (~40 km grid, so whole districts share a value). A model estimate, not a monitor reading.
datasets.source: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service near-real-time forecasts via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Population (GHSL)
datasets.description: Residents per cell from the JRC Global Human Settlement Layer GHS-POP R2023A (100 m), with 2000→2020 growth and the 2030 projection.
datasets.source: JRC GHSL GHS-POP R2023A via Earth Engine (pipeline/cells/ee_layers.py)

datasets.title: Rainfall (monthly total)
datasets.description: CHIRPS satellite-gauge rainfall summed per month. Native pixels are ~5.5 km, so this is drawn on ~3.9 km cells.
datasets.source: CHIRPS v2.0 daily (UCSB Climate Hazards Center) via Earth Engine (scripts/build_cell_timeseries.py)

datasets.title: Rainfall (CHIRPS)
datasets.description: CHIRPS v2 daily rainfall (satellite + station blend, ~5 km): 2025 totals, monsoon total, wettest day, IMD heavy-rain days and the 10-year mean.
datasets.source: UCSB Climate Hazards Center CHIRPS v2.0 daily via Earth Engine

datasets.title: Intelligence scores
datasets.description: ~20 composite urban scores (walkability, livability, flood risk…) precomputed per cell from a bulk OSM extract.
datasets.source: pipeline/scores/build_tile.py

datasets.title: Soil (OpenLandMap)
datasets.description: Topsoil (0 cm) clay, sand, organic carbon, pH and USDA texture class from OpenLandMap machine-learning soil maps (250 m). Under built-up land these are predicted, not sampled, values.
datasets.source: OpenLandMap soil v02 (Hengl et al., EnvirometriX) via Earth Engine

datasets.title: Land surface temperature
datasets.description: Pre-monsoon (Mar–Jun 2025) median surface temperature from Landsat 8/9 thermal (30 m, ~10:30 local), its anomaly against the city median (urban heat island), and MODIS day/night means (1 km). Surface, not air, temperature.
datasets.source: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 L2 + MODIS MOD11A2 v6.1 via Earth Engine

datasets.title: Terrain & drainage
datasets.description: Elevation, relief and slope from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM; height above nearest drainage (HAND, a flood-exposure proxy: low = close to a channel) from MERIT Hydro (90 m).
datasets.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 + MERIT Hydro v1.0.1 via Earth Engine
datasets.license: Copernicus DEM licence; MERIT Hydro CC BY-NC 4.0

datasets.title: Traffic congestion (structural)
datasets.description: Road-network betweenness → level-of-service per cell. Structural congestion, not live delays (docs/TRAFFIC_MODEL.md).
datasets.source: pipeline/traffic/traffic_grid.py

datasets.title: Vegetation & tree canopy
datasets.description: Sentinel-2 NDVI medians for 2025 (cloud-masked, annual, dry and post-monsoon) and Meta/WRI 1 m canopy height (mean height, share ≥ 5 m).
datasets.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A + Meta/WRI High Resolution Canopy Height via Earth Engine
datasets.license: Copernicus open licence; canopy height CC BY 4.0

datasets.title: Surface water & river flood hazard
datasets.description: Landsat-derived surface-water history (JRC Global Surface Water 1984–2021, 30 m) and modelled riverine flood extent/depth for 10- and 100-year return periods (Copernicus GloFAS flood hazard v2.1, ~90 m). The model ignores embankments and drains, and does not cover pluvial/urban waterlogging.
datasets.source: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 + CEMS GloFAS Flood Hazard v2.1 via Earth Engine
